title: The SpawnFn options param still declares `{ encoding: 'utf8'; stdio?: 'inherit'…
description:
The SpawnFn options param still declares `{ encoding: 'utf8'; stdio?: 'inherit' | 'pipe' }`, a node-era shape that Bun.spawnSync ignores (the default impl hardcodes per-stream inherit and never reads options). Vestigial but harmless; could be trimmed to just what the seam needs for clarity.

Source: cam/issue-308
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: 686169f87244

spec.scope: Trim the vestigial node-era `options` parameter shape (`{ encoding: 'utf8'; stdio?: 'inherit' | 'pipe' }`) from the SpawnFn seam type introduced by the CAM-308 migration. Bun.spawnSync ignores it (the default impl hardcodes per-stream inherit and never reads options). Reduce the type to only what the seam actually uses.
acceptanceCriteria: The SpawnFn options parameter no longer declares the node-era `{ encoding; stdio }` shape; the type reflects only what the Bun.spawnSync-based seam actually consumes.
All call sites still typecheck and the default SpawnFn impl behavior is unchanged.
gotchas: Vestigial and harmless today; dead-surface cleanup directly caused by the CAM-308 node->Bun.spawnSync migration.
